steps.name: cart-engine
steps.summary: src/types/session.ts (Source, CartLine, LineInput, LineChanges), src/lib/commands/errors.ts (ErrorCode, TemplateId, ChoiceRef, ErrorDetail, CommandError(code, message, detail), HTTP_STATUS), src/lib/commands/cart.ts (pure: MAX_LINES 20, MAX_QTY 10, resolveLine/unitPriceOf/cartTotal/addLine/updateLine/removeLine/sameLine; prices only from KioskData; selections normalized with empty groups omitted; sold out/off-hours give up to 2 same-category alternatives; missing required group without default gives NEEDS_CHOICE pick_option; duplicate option ids rejected; identical add merges qty and returns its lineId; updateLine merges named groups, drops groups not in the new variant, no merge with other lines; removeLine on unknown lineId is BAD_REQUEST; messages use English menu names), cart.test.ts (35 tests)

steps.name: state-machine
steps.summary: src/types/session.ts (+SessionStatus, DineOption, StaffReason, ChangeKind, Actor, Session), src/lib/commands/session.ts (SESSION_TTL_MS 10 min, newSession), schemas.ts (zod strict envelope + discriminated union per type, parseCommand → BAD_REQUEST; ids ^[a-z0-9_]+$ ≤64 incl. lineId, so the session service must generate matching lineIds; choice ids also accept variant names like largeSet), actors.ts (ACTOR_COMMANDS phone/kiosk sets), machine.ts (pure applyCommand: actor → duplicate → GONE → paid-only-callStaff → state rules; UNDO_DEPTH 5, RECENT_COMMANDS 30, CONFIRM_WAIT_MS 1500; kiosk confirm needs source touch, phone needs button or newer utteranceSeq + 1.5 s; editOrder resets checkoutAt so an AI confirm waits again; undo/clear set lastChange.lineId null and keep screen; reissueClaim only checks state; addToCart result has lineId and once-per-order upsell), machine.test.ts (75 tests); ISSUE I-024/I-025 contract-drift, RULE R-002 (proposed)

steps.name: session-store
steps.summary: src/lib/tokens.ts (newToken 32B / newSessionId 16B base64url, hashToken SHA-256 hex, tokenMatches timingSafeEqual), src/lib/store/{types,memory,firestore,index}.ts (SessionStore + SessionSecrets; MemoryStore: structuredClone, per-id promise chain, async notify; FirestoreStore: firebase-admin loaded lazily on first use, sessions + sessionSecrets in one runTransaction, createdAt/expiresAt as Timestamp, undoStack stored as [{lines}] because Firestore has no nested arrays; getStore singleton, STORE default firestore in production else memory, unknown STORE throws), src/lib/session/service.ts (createSession/claimSession/runCommand/ping; randomness outside transact fn; lineIds are 8 random bytes hex to match the schema id pattern (I-026); order number 101-999; expired sessions written as `expired` before GONE in claim/command/ping; secrets.expiresAt follows every session extension so TTL never deletes live secrets; reissueClaim rotates claim hash, clears device hash and phoneConnectedAt, returns result.claimToken; actor = kiosk if kiosk hash matches, else phone, else UNAUTHORIZED); tests: tokens 4, memory 8, service 17, firestore.it (skipped unless FIRESTORE_IT=1; `npm run test:firestore` passed against kibo-2026)
